nodes.guardrail: Before deepening tech, verify that your army can defend against early ling floods or timing attacks. If not, prioritize building a defensive ground force.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when more enemy units are scouted or when transitioning to mid-game.

nodes.guardrail: Ensure your ground army is sufficient to hold against potential Zergling aggression before continuing tech. If under pressure, prioritize production and defense.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition changes.

nodes.guardrail: Before investing further in upgrades, confirm that your army composition can handle Zergling and Roach compositions. If not, adjust to include more anti-ground units.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition changes.

nodes.guardrail: Maintain a defensive posture and ensure your ground forces are sufficient to repel Roach attacks before focusing on economy. If vulnerable, prioritize defense.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition changes.

nodes.guardrail: Before expanding, verify that your army can defend against Zergling pressure. If not, prioritize army production and defense over expansion.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when expansions are secure or when opponent pressure is detected.

nodes.guardrail: Ensure your Phoenix count is sufficient to deal with Mutalisks and Overseers before committing further to air. If not, consider adding ground support or more Phoenixes.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent tech switches to anti-air or when air army is sufficient.

nodes.guardrail: Before expanding, verify that your Zealot force can hold against Queen-based aggression. If not, prioritize defense and army production.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when more enemy information is available or when transitioning to mid-game.

nodes.guardrail: Ensure your Void Rays are protected from anti-air threats before committing further. If opponent shows signs of anti-air, diversify your army composition.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent tech switches to anti-air or when air army is sufficient.

nodes.guardrail: Before developing further, confirm that your Zealot army can withstand Zergling aggression. If not, prioritize stabilizing your defense and production.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when the situation stabilizes or when opponent tech changes.

nodes.guardrail: Ensure your Phoenixes can handle Mutalisks and Roaches before continuing air investment. If not, consider adding ground units or more Phoenixes.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent tech switches to anti-air or when air army is sufficient.
